3987.title: Active-thread admission before host readiness
3987.rootCauseOneLine: Host readiness returns a queued result before current thread state is refreshed and explicit active-thread starts are rejected.
3987.proposedFix: Refresh persisted thread state and reject explicit active-thread starts before host readiness; preserve queue-if-active host waits.
3987.caveats: Deterministic server-level reproduction; no real host resume or browser exercised.
